انتقعوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَعُوا (intaqaʕū) /in.ta.qa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# اُنْتُقِعُوا (untuqiʕū) /un.tu.qi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# اِنْتَقِعُوا (intaqiʕū) /in.ta.qi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
